# Environment profiles

## Profile requirements

The profiles below define information to prepare before execution. They are environment contract categories, not assigned machines, installed toolchains or measured results. No ENV identities or reusable environment registry are introduced. Each RUN record retains its actual inline environment and deviations.

| Category | Required declaration | Evidence boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Correctness / compatibility | Pinned compiler, dependencies, features, OS/architecture, inputs and exact command | Correctness/build observations for the declared configuration |
| Concurrency / model | Memory model, tool/version, explored bounds, target assumptions and controls | Model bounds and supported invariants; stress remains supplementary |
| Controlled performance | CPU/board/DIMMs, BIOS, NUMA/SMT/IRQ/affinity, power policy, load, timing endpoints and instrumentation | Adopted workload/budgets on a controlled platform; shared CI does not establish timing-sensitive acceptance |
| Documentary review | Source edition/version, retrieval/archive date, claim scope, checklist, reviewer and artifact integrity | Source/claim review; no inferred runtime measurements |

Use the [hardware setup](../06-benchmarking/hardware-setup.md), [workload definitions](../06-benchmarking/workload-definitions.md) and [performance profiles](../00-governance/performance-profiles.md) when preparing controlled runs. Existing hardware proposals are not assigned Lab machines.
